key_insight: CBPO unifies supervised and reinforcement-style reasoning training by turning offline demonstrations and policy rollouts into a single shared regression target, so all collected responses can be reused in one replay buffer.
engineering_relevance: This simplifies reasoning post-training by avoiding separate SFT/RL objectives, importance weighting, stored behavior-policy probabilities, and critic learning while still enabling offline, on-policy, and off-policy training.
method: Uses a fixed-reference target that does not depend on the generating policy.
Allows positive/negative offline completions, reference answers, and historical rollouts to share one reward-labeled format.
Supports offline, on-policy, off-policy, and unified CBPO variants under the same regression objective.
evidence_signal: Across two model scales and four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CBPO reported leading avg@32 and pass@32 results; on Qwen3-1.7B, CBPO-Unified improved benchmark-averaged avg@32 and pass@32 over SFT DAPO by 2.33 and 4.44 points, and replay history added another 1.87 and 3.72 points.
watch_item: The approach depends on a fixed-reference regression setup, so performance may be sensitive to how targets are constructed and how stale historical rollouts are managed in the buffer.
paper_title: Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization: Unified Learning from Offline Demonstrations and On- and Off-Policy Rollouts via a Shared Regression Target
